text.text:
Hidden in the NTNU shopping district 🏠

(Very close to the NTNU swimming pool) Pasta from $160 💰 Free rice and noodle refills are available – incredibly generous!

The key point is that the dishes are all made with high-quality ingredients and taste delicious 😽 The sauces are all handmade and simmered for a long time by the restaurant, not using pre-packaged sauces.

I especially love the savory beef sauce 🍅 And the refreshing and not-too-greasy classic pesto 🌿 The white sauce is also delicious with baked dishes~~

Besides sauces, you can also choose your favorite main course and rice/noodle type: pasta, penne, baked dishes ✨, and even an omelet rice option! The main course selection is also extensive; I highly recommend the double mushroom chicken and the seafood selection!

Alternatively, for those with a large appetite, there's the A set meal 🍝, which includes soup and bread 🥯. I recommend upgrading the soup to the puff pasta corn chowder! The crispy crust was fragrant and delicious!

Other fried items: American-style crispy fries, chewy two-color balls, and Chicken McNuggets were also good 👌🏻

The store was clean and bright, and the staff were very friendly and helpful 🥰

If it were near my home, I would definitely come here often!! Sharing this with everyone 🫶🏻

originalText.text:
隱身在師大商圈🏠
（＊離師大遊泳池那邊很近）
義大利麵$160起💰
可以免費加飯加麵超佛心

重點是餐點也都很真材實料又好吃😽
醬汁都是店家手工長時間熬煮 而不是使用調理包
我很喜歡充滿牛肉香氣的紅番肉醬🍅
還有清爽不膩的經典青醬🌿
白醬搭配焗烤也很好吃～～

除了醬之外 還可以自選喜歡的主菜＆飯麵類型
條麵、斜管麵、焗烤系列✨甚至還有蛋包飯的選項
主菜的選擇也很豐富 很推雙菇嫩雞、海匯鮮選！

另外大食量可以點 A 套餐🍝
會有濃湯＋麵包🥯
湯推薦升級成酥皮玉米濃湯！酥皮很香很好吃
其他炸物：美式脆薯、QQ 雙色球、麥克雞塊也都不錯👌🏻

店內環境乾淨明亮 店員很親切介紹🥰
如果開在家裡附近我會很常來買！！分享給大家🫶🏻

text.text: The crispy chowder was disappointing; the broth lacked cream and was more like a mushy corn soup. The garlic slices were good, and the baked pasta was decent, though the portion was generous. Overall, nothing particularly memorable, but it's suitable for students. The chowder really needs improvement.

originalText.text: 脆皮濃湯令人失望，濃湯湯底沒有奶油，是糊糊的玉米湯。蒜片好吃，焗烤義大利麵中規中矩，份量不小。整體沒什麼記憶點，很適合學生吃。濃湯真的要改進才行。

text.text:
There's a paid parking lot a 5-7 minute walk away, and the restaurant has plenty of seating. On a Saturday noon, there was no waiting, and the staff were very attentive.

You need to fill out a card to order and then pay at the counter. The restaurant is spacious and has restrooms.

The tomato meat sauce rice (I thought it was risotto but it was just plain white rice, but it was still quite delicious) was good. My boyfriend ordered tomato meat sauce spaghetti with extra noodles; the portion was very filling for a guy.

The gifts for becoming a member are very generous. This time, I redeemed two slices of garlic pesto bread, which were toasted quite crispy.

originalText.text:
附近走路5-7分鐘處有付費停車場，店內位置挺多，星期六中午來不需候位，店員也積極上前招呼。

點餐需自行填卡再至櫃檯結帳，店內位置寬敞，有廁所。

番茄肉醬飯（以為是燉飯結果是完整的白飯，但也挺美味的。男友點了番茄肉醬義大利麵加麵，加麵後份量以男生來說可以吃超飽。

加入會員好友的贈禮很大方，這次兌換贈送的蒜味青醬麵包一共兩片，烤的挺酥脆的。

text.text: Honestly, I'm an absolute loyal customer. After discovering this place, I eat here about twice a week. I absolutely love their pesto; no one can compete with me for number one. Nobody knows how much I love their pesto... You absolutely must try their seafood platter (about two or three shrimp, two squid, and one or two pieces of basa fish). It's really delicious. Even though it's within a five-minute walk of my house, I either order delivery or pick it up at the store, and I dine in quite a few times. It's so incredibly delicious... The shrimp are even naked! The soup is also good, though a little on the sweeter side. Seafood chowder (one shrimp, one fish, one squid, and two clams). But lately, I've fallen in love with the shrimp and shellfish combo—it's just too good!
